scheme_name: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Fishing Boats (Catamarans)
other_conditions: Must be engaged in fishing activities.
Must be interested in availing loan for Fishing Boats (Catamarans) from the Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank.
Must intend to use the loan specifically for purchasing a fishing boat (Catamaran).
benefits_summary: Loan of ₹15,000 to ₹60,000 for purchasing fishing boats (Catamarans) at bank‑determined interest rates.
